samples.summary: The outline's `structuralEditable` prediction is no longer in step with what the injector will do — §5.10's stated contract is broken by this PR and neither extract.mjs nor §5.10 was updated.
samples.evidence:
Engine doc §5.10 (docs/design/design-editor/design-editor-engine.md:904-931) makes `structuralEditable` a *prediction* of the structural ops, and states that "a prediction that disagrees with the resolver is worse than a missing one: the UI offers a control, the designer uses it, and the server refuses." This PR moves two guards out of `resolveNode` and into op-specific behaviour, and the prediction was not moved with them:

(a) NEW REFUSAL, over-prediction: `applyLayoutRemove` (inject.mjs:695-716) now refuses any node whose `parentPath` is empty — i.e. every direct child of a returned FRAGMENT. `extract.mjs:552-556` still reports `structuralEditable: true` for exactly those nodes (`scope==='static'`, tag not `#returns`, `owner===node`, and they are not in `returnedJsx` because the fragment is, not its children). The outline will therefore enable "remove" on `return <><A/><B/></>`'s children and the server will refuse — the precise failure §5.10 exists to prevent. The doc's own §5.7 addition (lines 820-826) documents the refusal but §5.10 was left describing the old four-way equivalence, and `extract.test.mjs`'s node-by-node agreement assertion compares against `resolveNode` with the default role, so it stays green while the UI contract is broken.

(b) NEW ALLOWANCE, under-prediction: `role: 'container'` now admits a returned root and a `{cond && …}` element as insert targets, but there is only the one `structuralEditable` flag, so the outline still greys out "insert child" for the very "insert into the page's root <div>" case the PR's rationale (jsx-nodes.mjs:774-787, doc lines 801-818) says it exists to unblock. Nothing in this diff adds a container-role flag to the node metadata.
searchedFor: glob packages/design-editor/src/**/* (no client/UI files exist yet)

samples.summary: Scope creep: a new prototype-pollution guard suite plus design-doc §5.11 land in the `inject.mjs` PR while testing only `jsx-nodes.mjs` / `extract.mjs` maps.
samples.evidence: design-editor-local-plugin.md §8 (line 301-310) scopes PRs 6–7 to "`inject.mjs` + tests". `name-keyed-maps.test.mjs` imports `analyzeClasses`, `analyzeNodes`, `analyzeScene` from `extract.mjs` and `findJsxRoots` from `jsx-nodes.mjs` and asserts nothing about `inject.mjs`; the accompanying doc §5.11 (engine doc lines 938-961) likewise documents an extract/jsx-nodes invariant. Both belong with PR 3/5 under the stated rollout granularity; folding them here enlarges the review surface the split was designed to bound.

samples.summary: The canonical doc describes an inject.mjs API that this package's inject.mjs does not export, with no "not yet ported" marker.
samples.evidence: §5.1-§5.5 (lines 636-722) specify `applyClassRewrite`, `applyTokenValue`, `readSemanticBindings`, `insertSemanticToken`, `insertThemeMapping` etc. as functions of `src/server/inject.mjs`, and the newly added §5.12 (line 971) asserts "`renderAttribute` and `applyTokenValue`'s `valueKind` already refuse on that basis". The file landed here exports only `applyLayoutProps`, `applyLayoutInsert`, `applyLayoutRemove`, `insertImport`, `removeImport`, `unifiedDiff`. The split is planned (local-plugin §8), but the engine doc — which opens by claiming it is "derived strictly from the current source" — now over-states the shipped surface, and nested design docs are not link/ref-checked by CI. Relatedly, §5.7 line 742 still gives `NodeAnchor = { file, component, path[], tag, fp, fpx? }` while the code's typedef (inject.mjs:39-42) has no `file`.

samples.summary: `nodeAtPath` re-implements the exported `nodeAt` from `jsx-nodes.mjs` rather than extending it.
samples.evidence: jsx-nodes.mjs:910-921 exports `nodeAt(_sf, root, path)`, whose body is the same `childrenOf` walk; the private copy at inject.mjs:731-745 differs only in also returning the child's `scope`. The engine doc's own rule (lines 146-152) is that the numbering has three consumers and "must never be reimplemented", and this PR's shared-helper argument for `rewriteClassLiteral` is the same anti-drift reasoning applied inconsistently. Widening `nodeAt` (or exporting a `nodeEntryAt`) would keep one walker.

samples.summary: A 15-line placeholder banner and shared-helper rationale describe code that does not exist in this PR.
samples.evidence: inject.mjs:274-289 is a comment block for the "TOKEN MUTATION" half plus a justification for why `rewriteClassLiteral`/`removeNodeLine`/`indentOf` sit in a "shared" section — but no second consumer exists yet, so `rewriteClassLiteral`'s "chokepoint both halves share" framing (inject.mjs:168-186) is speculative documentation of a future PR inside shipped source.

samples.summary: The class-validation chokepoint is justified by citing an unrelated invariant's test file.
samples.evidence: inject.mjs:180-185 argues for centralised validation because "a check at each call site is the arrangement that already failed once, in the re-keying hazard `test/server/name-keyed-maps.test.mjs` exists to prevent". That test guards prototype-keyed maps in `extract.mjs`/`jsx-nodes.mjs`, not per-call-site class-token validation; the cross-reference conflates two different failures the PR's own doc §5.11 says "need different guards".

verdict.reason: The absence claim holds on both halves. (a) `extract.mjs:552-556` still derives `structuralEditable` from only the four original guards, and `extract.test.mjs:380-387` explicitly asserts `true` for both children of `return <><A/><B/></>` — while `applyLayoutRemove` (`inject.mjs:687-708`) now refuses exactly those nodes ("container has no anchor — removing it could not be undone"), asserted in `inject.test.mjs:330-342`. So the outline's prediction and the injector disagree for that shape, which is the failure §5.10 exists to prevent. The drift guard cannot catch it because `extract.test.mjs:353-357` calls `resolveNode` with only `{requireStatic: true}` (default role), which still locates the node. (b) §5.10 (`design-editor-engine.md:904-931`) still states the flag "mirrors the resolver guard for guard" and reprints the four-line rule; the new refusal is documented only in §5.7 (`:820-826`) in injector terms, and §5.10 has no mention of it or of `opts.role`. No container-role flag exists anywhere: repo-wide grep for `structuralEditable|containerEditable|insertChild|canInsert|childEditable` yields only `extract.mjs:552`, `types.ts:116` and tests, and `SceneNodeMeta` (`types.ts:92-121`) has just `structuralEditable`/`repeated`/`clickSelectable`, so the `role:'container'` allowance added at `jsx-nodes.mjs:792,859` and used at `inject.mjs:602` is not surfaced to the outline. No counterexample found; searched the whole repo for other consumers of `SceneNodeMeta` (none outside this package) and all four design-editor docs.
